en.headline: Six injured after minibus and van collide in Kwai Chung
en.dek: A light goods vehicle and a green minibus crashed at the junction of Kwai Fuk Road and Shing Fuk Street on Sunday night; all six casualties were conscious.
body: Six people were injured on Sunday night after a light goods vehicle and a green minibus collided at the junction of Kwai Fuk Road and Shing Fuk Street in Kwai Chung, police said.
The incident occurred around 9pm. All six injured persons were conscious and were taken to Princess Margaret Hospital for treatment. Police are investigating the cause of the accident.
The minibus driver was reportedly trapped in the vehicle but managed to free himself.

zh.headline: 葵涌小巴與貨車相撞 六人受傷
zh.dek: 周日晚葵涌葵福路與盛福街交界一輛輕型貨車與綠色小巴相撞，六名傷者清醒送院。
body: 警方表示，周日晚約9時，葵涌葵福路與盛福街交界發生交通意外，一輛輕型貨車與一輛綠色小巴相撞，造成六人受傷。
六名傷者均清醒，被送往瑪嘉烈醫院治理。警方正調查事故原因。
據報小巴司機一度被困，但其後自行脫困。
